block.description: This is for refreshing Venafi tokens for use with venafi-provider.

access_token.description: Access token used for authorization to TLSPDC

client_id.description: Application that will be using the token

expiration.description: Expiration date of the access token

p12_cert_filename.description: base64-encoded PKCS#12 keystore containing a vcert certificate, private key, and chain certificates to authenticate to TLSPDC

p12_cert_password.description: Password for the PKCS#12 keystore declared in p12_cert

password.description: Password to authenticate to TLSPDC and request a new token

refresh_token.description: Token used to request a new token pair (access/refresh token) from a TLSPDC instance

refresh_window.description: number of days before expiration where a token refresh should be done

trust_bundle.description: Use to specify a base64-encoded, PEM-formatted file that contains certificates to be trust anchors for all communications with the Venafi TLSPDC instance

url.description: The Venafi TLSPDC URL. Example: https://tpp.venafi.example/vedsdk

username.description: Username to authenticate to TLSPDC and request a new token
